summary.key_theme: Netflix 面臨高層人事異動、裁員壓力與成長放緩的挑戰，市場正密切關注即將公布的財報以尋求成長動能。

bullish.title: Jefferies Makes a Bold $85 Call on Netflix Stock
bullish.reason: Jefferies 給予 Netflix 「買入」評級與 85 美元目標價，看好其廣告業務、定價能力與體育直播帶來的潛在成長。

bearish.title: Netflix's content calendar, layoffs prompt harsh response from fund manager
bearish.reason: 基金經理人指出會員流失、內容排程乏力及裁員問題，導致其決定賣出持股，反映市場對公司營運策略的擔憂。

bearish.title: Netflix Needs Another 'Squid Game' Moment As Growth Pressure Mounts
bearish.reason: 公司面臨巨大的成長壓力，急需像《魷魚遊戲》等級的爆款內容來提振用戶參與度與訂閱成長。

bearish.title: Netflix cut 1,000 jobs. Here' why and how it impacts your subscription
bearish.reason: 大規模裁員 1,000 人引發市場對公司內部穩定性與未來內容產出能力的質疑。

bearish.title: Skydance is real threat to Netflix, pricing power is a concern: G Squared's Greene
bearish.reason: 分析師指出 Skydance 等競爭對手構成實質威脅，且 Netflix 在面對競爭時的定價能力受到市場質疑。

bearish.title: Netflix isn't broken, but there's an urgency to grow faster: LightShed's Rich Greenfield
bearish.reason: 專家認為公司雖未崩潰，但成長速度已無法滿足市場預期，急需調整策略。

neutral.title: Netflix replacing chief content officer Bela Bajaria with former Disney executive Peter Rice
neutral.reason: Netflix 宣布由前 Disney 高管 Peter Rice 接替 Bela Bajaria 擔任首席內容官，此人事變動對公司長期戰略影響尚待觀察。

neutral.title: Netflix (NFLX) To Report Earnings Tomorrow: Here Is What To Expect
neutral.reason: 市場例行性報導財報前瞻，投資人正等待具體數據以決定後續方向。

neutral.title: Options Action: Calls outpacing puts in Netflix
neutral.reason: 期權市場活動顯示投資人對財報前的波動有所準備，但未明確指向單一方向。

neutral.title: What To Expect In Markets This Week: SPCX, TSLA, META, NFLX, IBM Earnings And More
neutral.reason: 將 Netflix 列入本週財報觀察名單，屬於市場常規分析。

neutral.title: Netflix Stock Has Been on a Roll. Here’s Where It Could Go Next.
neutral.reason: 探討股價在經歷近期波動後的技術面走勢，未提供基本面利多或利空訊息。
